headline: Russia Opens Terrorism Case Over Ukraine Drone Attack on Oil Refinery
summary: Russia opened a terrorism case after a massive drone attack caused significant damage to what Ukraine described as one of Russia's largest oil refineries.
why: Attacks on key energy infrastructure within major producing nations threaten global supply chains and heighten geopolitical risk premiums for crude oil.
why_moved: Physical disruptions to major refining facilities raise concerns over near-term product shortages, prompting upward pressure on energy markets.
